title: data/n8n-alerts.json
description: What has already been said, so it is not said again. Written by src/n8n/report.js. Without this, one workflow failing on a 6-hourly timer mails everybody four times a day until it is fixed, and the twenty-first mail is the one nobody reads — including the one that matters.

lastReportedOn.description: ISO date of the last scheduled digest. One a day, not one per pass

sent.description: Keyed <workflowKey>:<alertKind>. Value is when it last went out; the cooldown is measured from there.

count.description: How many times this alert has been suppressed-or-sent since it first fired, so the mail can say "still failing, 4th report"
